Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 7
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misinterpreted the question by conflating “tallest building outside North America” with “the world’s tallest moving outside North America,” incorrectly proposing the Petronas Towers in Kuala Lumpur. This ignored evidence already surfaced indicating that Bank of China Tower in Hong Kong surpassed One Raffles Place in 1989, leading away from the correct city (Hong Kong).
